mapper.select: SELECT * FROM meeting_rooms WHERE active = true ORDER BY location, name

SELECT mr.* FROM meeting_rooms mr WHERE mr.active = true AND mr.id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT b.meeting_room_id FROM bookings b WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ((b.start_time < #{endTime} AND b.end_time > #{startTime})) ) ORDER BY mr.location, mr.name

SELECT * FROM meeting_rooms WHERE active = true
AND location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%')
AND capacity >= #{minCapacity}
AND JSON_CONTAINS(equipments, CONCAT('"', #{equipment}, '"'))
ORDER BY location, name

SELECT mr.* FROM meeting_rooms mr WHERE mr.active = true
AND mr.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%')
AND mr.capacity >= #{minCapacity}
AND JSON_CONTAINS(mr.equipments, CONCAT('"', #{equipment}, '"'))
AND mr.id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT b.meeting_room_id FROM bookings b WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ((b.start_time < #{endTime} AND b.end_time > #{startTime})) ) ORDER BY mr.location, mr.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_rooms (id, name, location, capacity, equipments, active) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{location}, #{capacity}, #{equipments}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE meeting_rooms SET name = #{name}, location = #{location}, capacity = #{capacity}, equipments = #{equipments}, active = #{active}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
